shape: A web page redesign in markdown: how the page was, what the person did, how it is now, and what changed, with timings before and after.
tests: Layout: before and after. What changed is said with the figures as written; no percentage is worked out. The pictures are mentioned in the material and never described or marked by the draft.

keyFacts.fact: The old page was a scanned timetable shown as one image, too small to read on a phone.
The new page shows the next three departures from the chosen stop, at the top.
Looking up the next bus took a median of 48 seconds before and 9 seconds after.
3 of 9 students gave up on the old page; all 9 finished on the new one.
Emails asking for bus times fell from about 30 a week to about 8.

forbidden.why: The material gives the before and after figures and no percentage change.
The AI never sees the pictures, so it can't say what a screenshot shows.
